---
title: "Immigration Narrative and Enforcement Analysis Pipeline"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(broom)
library(glue)

# create output folders
dir.create("../outputs/figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../outputs/tables", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)

# -----------------------------
# LOAD DATA
# -----------------------------
gdelt <- read_csv("../gdelt_gkg_immigration_monthly.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
reddit <- read_csv("../data/processed/reddit_llm_monthly.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
ice <- read_csv("../ice_monthly.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
cbp <- read_csv("../cbp_monthly.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

gdelt <- gdelt %>% mutate(month = as.Date(month))
reddit <- reddit %>% mutate(month = as.Date(month))
ice <- ice %>% mutate(month = as.Date(month))
cbp <- cbp %>% mutate(month = as.Date(month))

df <- gdelt %>%
  full_join(reddit, by = "month") %>%
  full_join(ice, by = "month") %>%
  full_join(cbp, by = "month") %>%
  arrange(month) %>%
  mutate(
    news_z = scale(n_articles)[,1],
    cbp_z = scale(encounters)[,1],
    ice_z = scale(arrests)[,1],
    sentiment_z = scale(avg_sentiment)[,1],
    divergence_cbp = news_z - cbp_z
  )

# -----------------------------
# TABLES
# -----------------------------
summary_tbl <- tibble(
  Measure = c("News article volume", "News tone", "Reddit post volume", "ICE arrests", "CBP encounters"),
  Mean = c(
    mean(gdelt$n_articles, na.rm=TRUE),
    mean(gdelt$mean_tone, na.rm=TRUE),
    mean(reddit$n_posts, na.rm=TRUE),
    mean(ice$arrests, na.rm=TRUE),
    mean(cbp$encounters, na.rm=TRUE)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(Mean = round(Mean, 2))

overlap_tbl <- tibble(
  Measure = c("News coverage", "CBP encounters", "ICE arrests", "Reddit sentiment"),
  Months = c(
    sum(!is.na(df$n_articles)),
    sum(!is.na(df$encounters)),
    sum(!is.na(df$arrests)),
    sum(!is.na(df$avg_sentiment))
  )
)

write_csv(summary_tbl, "../outputs/tables/summary_statistics.csv")
write_csv(overlap_tbl, "../outputs/tables/data_overlap.csv")

# -----------------------------
# MODEL
# -----------------------------
reg_df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(news_z), !is.na(cbp_z))

model <- lm(cbp_z ~ news_z, data = reg_df)
reg_df$resid <- residuals(model)

# -----------------------------
# FIGURE 1: STANDARDIZED TRENDS
# -----------------------------
p1 <- df %>%
  select(month, news_z, cbp_z, ice_z) %>%
  pivot_longer(-month) %>%
  ggplot(aes(month, value, color=name)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  geom_line(size=1) +
  labs(
    title="Standardized Trends: Narratives vs Enforcement",
    subtitle="Series do not move together consistently",
    x="", y="Standardized value", color=""
  )

ggsave("../outputs/figures/figure1_standardized_trends.png", p1, width=10, height=5)
print(p1)

# -----------------------------
# FIGURE 2: DIVERGENCE
# -----------------------------
p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(month, divergence_cbp)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  geom_line(color="purple", size=1) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin=0, ymax=pmax(divergence_cbp,0)),
    fill="purple", alpha=0.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title="Divergence Between Narrative Salience and Enforcement",
    subtitle="Positive values indicate narrative exceeds benchmark",
    x="", y="News - CBP"
  )

ggsave("../outputs/figures/figure2_narrative_enforcement_divergence.png", p2, width=10, height=5)
print(p2)

# -----------------------------
# FIGURE 3: REGRESSION
# -----------------------------
r2 <- round(summary(model)$r.squared,3)

p3 <- ggplot(reg_df, aes(news_z, cbp_z)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  annotate("text", x = -1, y = 1.5,
           label = paste0("R² = ", r2, "\nWeak relationship")) +
  labs(
    title = "News vs CBP Encounters",
    subtitle = "Narrative indicators explain limited variation",
    x = "News (z)", y = "CBP (z)"
  )

ggsave("../outputs/figures/figure3_news_cbp_regression.png", p3, width = 8, height = 5)
print(p3)

# -----------------------------
# APPENDIX FIGURES
# -----------------------------

p4 <- bind_rows(
  ice %>% mutate(series="ICE", value=arrests),
  cbp %>% mutate(series="CBP", value=encounters)
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(month, value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~series, scales="free_y")

ggsave("../outputs/figures/appendix_raw_enforcement_trends.png", p4, width=8, height=6)

p5 <- ggplot(reg_df, aes(month, resid)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Residual mismatch")

ggsave("../outputs/figures/appendix_residual_mismatch.png", p5, width = 10, height = 4)
print(p5)

p6 <- df %>%
  select(month, sentiment_z, cbp_z, news_z) %>%
  pivot_longer(-month) %>%
  ggplot(aes(month, value, color=name)) +
  geom_line()

ggsave("../outputs/figures/appendix_sentiment_news_cbp_comparison.png", p6, width=10, height=5)

p7 <- ggplot(df, aes(sentiment_z, cbp_z)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method="lm")

ggsave("../outputs/figures/appendix_sentiment_cbp_regression.png", p7, width=8, height=5)

# -----------------------------
# DIAGNOSTICS
# -----------------------------
cor(df$news_z, df$cbp_z, use = "complete.obs")
cor(df$sentiment_z, df$cbp_z, use = "complete.obs")

augment(model) %>%
  arrange(desc(.cooksd)) %>%
  head()

cor(df$news_z, dplyr::lag(df$cbp_z), use="complete.obs")
cor(dplyr::lag(df$news_z), df$cbp_z, use="complete.obs")
```
